title: Sensitivity of central nervous system tumour mortality estimates to tumour-behaviour coding, and the contribution of population ageing, in 26 European countries, 2003–22: analysis code
description:
Analysis code and documentation for the study "Sensitivity of central nervous system tumour mortality estimates to tumour-behaviour coding, and the contribution of population ageing, in 26 European countries, 2003–22: a population-based study".

The pipeline (Python and R) reconstructs the analysis from published aggregate data: WHO Mortality Database, Eurostat, UN World Population Prospects 2024, Office for National Statistics (England) and the Belgian Cancer Registry. It compares CNS tumour mortality on malignant codes (ICD-10 C70–C72) and on a combined CNS-code outcome (adding D32–D33 and D42–D43), decomposes the change in deaths between 2003–05 and 2020–22, evaluates projection models out of sample and projects deaths to 2040. Source data are not included; data/README.md describes how to obtain them, with checksums of the files used.

Study protocol: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23797629.
